scripts.build:ui: bun install --cwd ui --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run --cwd ui build && bun scripts/embed-ui.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun scripts/embed-catalog.ts && bun build --compile --minify src/cli/main.ts --outfile dist/pmcpg
scripts.website: bun install --cwd website --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd website dev
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run check && bun test && bun run build && ./dist/pmcpg version
